page.layout: One printed page: running head at top, page number 266 at top left; main text in one column of verse with headings; an emblem motto ornament at left margin; a catchword "Non" at lower right. Faint show-through from the reverse page appears at the right and is omitted.

main_text.p: Sin eadem morti soluantur debita, tandem Confurgent medio splendidiora die.
main_text.head: Stulta admirationis affectatio ex Ouid. Metamorph.
main_text.p: Glauce, quid assiduè liquidis versaris in vndis? Cur flumen domus est, & cibus herba tibi? Naturæ morīque hominum contrarius, optas Te populus mirans dictitet, Hic vir, hic est. Mirari non est laudare. Popellus inepta Miratur: laudant sed bona sola boni.
main_text.head: Christiano Martiali. Vita beata.
main_text.p: Vitam quæ faciunt beatiorem, Dilectissime Martialis, hæc sunt; Veri notit à Dei suique, Mens clarata, timens, amans colénsque Notum pectore puriore numen: Abstiftens procul à malo; bonóque Hærens firmiter, adiuuare cunctos Constans, atque volens obesse nulli: Sanus corpore, sanus & cerebro: Non torpere graui solens veterno: Ast incumbere sedulus labori: In commune bonum referre vota: Recti iudicij regente norma: Gnarus mœstitiæ metu vacare, Grandi & lætitiæ carere motu. Et non forte nimis tumere lata: Et non forte nimis leui retundi: Quicquid contigerit, Deo volenti Se summittere, siue læta flarit, Illætrabilis aura seu reflarit.

page.notes: The emblem ornament at the left margin (a stylised woodcut motto with pen-like strokes) is not transcribed. Faint show-through from the facing page is omitted. The word "Non" at lower right is treated as a catchword. Some letters in the verse are uncertain and may be misread (e.g. "Hærens", "Illætrabilis", "Gnarus"). The lower right "Non" is faint and may be a catchword rather than a footnote.
